json.description: Source of truth for the open/closed pill. Required — without this block every <span data-aed-business-hours> on the page stays hidden.

timezone.description: IANA zone, e.g. 'America/Chicago'. DST-aware. Falls back to the visitor's resolved timezone if omitted.

hours.description: Weekly schedule. Keys: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun. Each value is an array of { open: 'HH:MM', close: 'HH:MM' } ranges. Empty array = closed all day.

soonMinutes.description: Minutes-to-open or minutes-to-close threshold for showing 'Opening soon' / 'Closing soon' status.

exceptions.description: One-off date overrides. Each entry: { date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', closed?: true, hours?: [...], label?: 'Closed for Christmas' }.
